name: apple-passwords
title: Apple Passwords
description: Apple's Passwords app: category tiles with counts (All, Passkeys, Codes, Wi-Fi, Security, Deleted) and shared groups, a searchable item list, and a detail with copy buttons, a password that morphs into view, verification codes with a countdown ring, a “Copied” HUD, edit mode, security recommendations by severity, Wi-Fi networks with a QR code, and Developer Sign-In buttons (GitHub, Fly.io, Netlify, Replay) that run a device-code login in a sheet and save the token as an item. Three columns on desktop, two on tablet, a pushed stack on phones; light and dark.
